articles.title: BOJ to consider pausing bond taper next fiscal year, sources say
articles.content: The Bank of Japan is reportedly leaning towards pausing its bond purchase taper beyond next fiscal year, a move that would mark a significant shift in its quantitative tightening strategy. This decision is expected to be closely debated by the nine-member board, with some prioritizing investor sentiment and others advocating for a steady reduction of the BOJ's substantial balance sheet.

articles.title: Indian bonds draw buyers on RBI measures, softer oil
articles.content: Indian government bonds saw renewed buying on Tuesday. Lower oil prices and Reserve Bank of India measures to attract dollar inflows improved sentiment. India posted a current account surplus in the last quarter.

articles.title: Bonus issue alert! Brigade Enterprises sets record date for 1:3 bonus share reward
articles.content: Brigade Enterprises has fixed June 17 as the record date for its 1:3 bonus share issue after receiving shareholder approval through an e-voting postal ballot. articles.title: IndiGo shares gain 2% after analyst meet. Why Goldman, Morgan Stanley, others see up to 38% upside?
articles.content: IndiGo shares witnessed an uptick on Tuesday after its analyst meet, where management outlined strong long-term growth plans driven by rising air travel demand and international expansion. articles.title: Analysts see RBI measures steadying rupee, push back depreciation forecasts
articles.content: The Indian rupee strengthened as falling crude oil prices and central bank measures to attract dollar inflows bolstered sentiment. These steps aim to counter recent pressure that saw the rupee hit a record low.

articles.title: RBI offers concessional swaps, allows leverage for NRI deposits to drive forex inflows
articles.content: The Reserve Bank of India has introduced new foreign exchange measures. These include special swap facilities to encourage state-owned companies to raise funds abroad. Banks can now offer leverage on foreign currency non-resident deposits. These initiatives aim to boost overseas fundraising and deposit mobilization for Indian entities.

articles.title: Zepto IPO: Aadit Palicha, Kaivalya Vohra to hold stake; Nexus Ventures biggest seller in OFS
articles.content: Quick commerce firm Zepto's promoters will not dilute equity in its upcoming IPO, which aims to raise Rs 8,010 crore via fresh issue and an offer for sale (OFS) of up to Rs 11,000 crore. articles.title: Wipro's Rs 15,000-crore buyback opens June 11; entitlement ratio and key details announced
articles.content: IT major Wipro's Rs 15,000-crore share buyback offer will commence on June 11 and conclude on June 17, 2026. Small shareholders can tender 11 shares for every 56 held, while general category shareholders are entitled to tender 10 shares for every 197 held. The company will communicate acceptance or rejection by June 23, 2026.
